definitions.explanation: Driving faster than the posted {制限速度|せいげんそくど}. A traffic offense punished with demerit points and a fine, and with criminal penalties for large excesses.

examples.japanese: {速度違反|そくどいはん}でつかまった。
この{道|みち}は{速度違反|そくどいはん}の{取|と}り{締|し}まりが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: There are a lot of speeding crackdowns on this road.

examples.japanese: {高速道路|こうそくどうろ}では、{三十|さんじゅう}キロ{以上|いじょう}の{速度違反|そくどいはん}は{罰金|ばっきん}では{済|す}まないことがある。
examples.english: On the expressway, speeding by 30 km/h or more can amount to more than just a fine.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {速度違反|そくどいはん}でつかまる: to be caught speeding
- {速度違反|そくどいはん}の{取|と}り{締|し}まり: a speeding crackdown
- {速度違反|そくどいはん}を{犯|おか}す: to commit a speeding offense
- {速度違反|そくどいはん}{車両|しゃりょう}: a speeding vehicle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- スピード{違反|いはん}: the everyday spoken equivalent, more common in conversation
- {交通違反|こうつういはん}: traffic violation — the general category
- {制限速度|せいげんそくど}: speed limit — the rule that is being broken
